scanNote:
GRAMMAR REFERENCE, 3-BET (118-bet). Yuqorida chapda 'Grammar Reference'.

CHAP USTUN (Past Simple davomi):
'Spelling': • We add -d to verbs ending in -e. 'I live - I lived' • Verbs ending in consonant + y drop the -y and add -ied. 'I try - I tried' • Verbs ending in one stressed vowel between two consonants double the last consonant and take -ed. 'I stop - I stopped'
'Use': • We use the past simple for actions which happened in the past and won't happen again. 'He graduated from high school in 1998. (When did he graduate? In 1998.)' • We also use the past simple for actions which happened at a specific time in the past. 'He visited his grandparents last Sunday. (When? Last Sunday.)'
OCh KO'K QUTI: 'Time expressions used with the past simple: yesterday, last night/morning/evening etc, two weeks/a month etc ago, in 1964 etc.'
'Short Answers' (quti): Did I/you/he etc work ...? → Yes, I/you/he etc did. No, I/you/he etc didn't.
'USED TO': 'We use used to + infinitive to refer to past habits or states which don't exist any more. In such cases we can also use the past simple.' 'I used to work/worked as a cleaner at the local hospital (but I don't any more). I didn't use to wear glasses. Did you use to have long hair?'

O'NG USTUN:
Ko'k 'UNIT 3'. 'ORDER OF ADJECTIVES'. KO'K QUTI 'Order of Adjectives': • Adjectives describe nouns. They go before nouns. They have the same form in the singular and plural. (a blue car - two blue cars) • There are two types of adjectives: Opinion adjectives (beautiful, great, expensive etc) which show what we think of someone or something and fact adjectives (short, long, red etc) which show what someone or something really is. Opinion adjectives go before fact adjectives. 'She's wearing an expensive long dress.' • When there are two or more fact adjectives in a sentence, they usually go in the following order: 'Fact adjectives': size: small, big, short, long etc; weight: heavy, light etc; shape: triangular, round, rectangular, square etc; colour: dark/light blue, yellow, pink, cream, red, purple etc; material: cotton, leather, silk, plastic, woollen, nylon, metal, gold, silver, velvet, wooden, canvas etc. 'It's an expensive, short, black, leather jacket.'
'MAKING COMPARISONS'. KO'K JADVAL: adjective | comparative | superlative. one-syllable adjectives: cheap - cheaper - the cheapest; large - larger - the largest; big - bigger - the biggest. -y adjectives: noisy - noisier - the noisiest. adjectives with two or more syllables: expensive - more expensive - the most expensive. irregular adjectives: good - better - the best; bad - worse - the worst; much/many - more - the most; little - less - the least.

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '118'.

sections.title: Unit 2 - Past Simple (Spelling, Use); Used to
sections.titleUz: 2-unit - O'tgan oddiy zamon (imlo, ishlatilishi); Used to

exercises.instructionEn: Spelling of -ed. Use of the past simple. Time expressions: yesterday, last night/morning/evening, two weeks/a month ago, in 1964. Short answers: Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.
exercises.instructionUz: -ed imlosi. O'tgan oddiy zamon ishlatilishi. Vaqt iboralari: yesterday, last night/morning/evening, two weeks/a month ago, in 1964. Qisqa javoblar: Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.
exercises.explanationUz:
-ED IMLOSI:

  1 -e bilan tugasa → faqat -D:
    live → lived, dance → danced
  2 undosh + y → -y tushib -IED:
    try → tried, study → studied
  3 bitta urg'uli unli + undosh →
    undosh IKKILANADI + -ed:
    stop → stopped, plan → planned


PAST SIMPLE - IShLATILIShI:

  1 O'tmishda bo'lgan va yana
    takrorlanmaydigan ishlar:
    'He GRADUATED in 1998.'
  2 O'tmishdagi ANIQ VAQTDA bo'lgan
    ishlar:
    'He VISITED his grandparents
     last Sunday.'


VAQT IBORALARI:
  yesterday = kecha
  last night/morning/evening/week
    = o'tgan kecha/ertalab/kechqurun/
    hafta
  two weeks ago = ikki hafta oldin
  a month ago = bir oy oldin
  in 1964 = 1964 yilda

  ⚠ 'ago' - muddatdan KEYIN
  keladi.


QISQA JAVOBLAR:
  Did you work? → Yes, I did. / No,
    I didn't.


⚠ 'TO GRADUATE':

  = bitirmoq (o'quv yurtini).


⚠ 'HIGH SCHOOL':

  = o'rta maktab (yuqori sinflar).


⚠ 'SPECIFIC':

  = aniq, muayyan.

points.en: We add -d to verbs ending in -e. I live - I lived
points.uz: -e bilan tugagan fe'llarga -d qo'shamiz. I live - I lived

points.en: Verbs ending in consonant + y drop the -y and add -ied. I try - I tried
points.uz: Undosh + y bilan tugagan fe'llar -y ni tashlab -ied qo'shadi. I try - I tried

points.en: Verbs ending in one stressed vowel between two consonants double the last consonant and take -ed. I stop - I stopped
points.uz: Ikki undosh orasida bitta urg'uli unli bo'lgan fe'llar oxirgi undoshni ikkilantirib -ed oladi. I stop - I stopped

points.en: We use the past simple for actions which happened in the past and won't happen again. He graduated from high school in 1998. We also use it for actions which happened at a specific time in the past. He visited his grandparents last Sunday.
points.uz: O'tgan oddiy zamonni o'tmishda bo'lgan va yana takrorlanmaydigan ishlar uchun ishlatamiz. U 1998 yilda o'rta maktabni bitirdi. Uni o'tmishdagi aniq vaqtda bo'lgan ishlar uchun ham ishlatamiz. U o'tgan yakshanba buvi-buvasinikiga bordi.

points.en: Time expressions: yesterday, last night/morning/evening etc, two weeks/a month etc ago, in 1964 etc. Short answers: Did you work? Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.
points.uz: Vaqt iboralari: kecha, o'tgan kecha/ertalab/kechqurun, ikki hafta/bir oy oldin, 1964 yilda. Qisqa javoblar: Ishladingmi? Ha. / Yo'q.

exercises.instructionEn: Used to. We use used to + infinitive to refer to past habits or states which don't exist any more. In such cases we can also use the past simple. I used to work/worked as a cleaner at the local hospital (but I don't any more). I didn't use to wear glasses. Did you use to have long hair?
exercises.instructionUz: Used to. O'tmishdagi, endi mavjud bo'lmagan odat yoki holatlar uchun used to + infinitiv ishlatamiz. Bunday hollarda o'tgan oddiy zamonni ham ishlatishimiz mumkin. Men mahalliy kasalxonada farrosh bo'lib ishlardim (lekin endi yo'q). Men ko'zoynak taqmasdim. Sochingiz uzun edimi?
exercises.explanationUz:
USED TO - O'TMIShDAGI ODAT.

  USED TO + FE'L = ilgari ...
  qilardim (endi yo'q)

  'I USED TO WORK as a cleaner.'
  = Farrosh bo'lib ishlardim (endi
    ishlamayman).
  = 'I worked as a cleaner.' (past
    simple ham mumkin)


ShAKLI:
  TASDIQ: used to + fe'l
    'I used to wear glasses.'
  INKOR: didn't USE to + fe'l
    "I didn't use to wear glasses."
    ⚠ 'didn't USED to' - XATO!
  SO'ROQ: Did ... USE to + fe'l?
    'Did you use to have long
     hair?'


⚠ 'USED TO' va 'BE USED TO':

  used to work = ilgari ishlardim
  am used to working = ishlashga
    o'rganganman (boshqa ma'no!)


⚠ 'A CLEANER':

  = farrosh.


⚠ 'ANY MORE':

  = endi (inkorda).
  "I don't any more" = endi yo'q.

points.en: We use used to + infinitive to refer to past habits or states which don't exist any more. In such cases we can also use the past simple.
points.uz: O'tmishdagi, endi mavjud bo'lmagan odat yoki holatlar uchun used to + infinitiv ishlatamiz. Bunday hollarda o'tgan oddiy zamonni ham ishlatishimiz mumkin.

points.en: I used to work/worked as a cleaner at the local hospital (but I don't any more).
points.uz: Men mahalliy kasalxonada farrosh bo'lib ishlardim (lekin endi yo'q).

points.en: I didn't use to wear glasses. Did you use to have long hair?
points.uz: Men ko'zoynak taqmasdim. Sochingiz uzun edimi?

sections.title: Unit 3 - Order of Adjectives; Making Comparisons

exercises.instructionEn: Order of Adjectives. Adjectives describe nouns. They go before nouns. They have the same form in the singular and plural. Opinion adjectives go before fact adjectives. Fact adjectives order: size, weight, shape, colour, material. It's an expensive, short, black, leather jacket.
exercises.instructionUz: Sifatlar tartibi. Sifatlar otlarni tasvirlaydi. Ular otdan oldin keladi. Birlik va ko'plikda bir xil shaklda. Fikr sifatlari fakt sifatlaridan oldin keladi. Fakt sifatlari tartibi: o'lcham, og'irlik, shakl, rang, material. Bu qimmat, kalta, qora, teri kurtka.
exercises.explanationUz:
SIFATLAR TARTIBI.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ASOSIY QOIDALAR                 ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  1 Sifat OTDAN OLDIN: 'a blue car'
  2 Ko'plikda O'ZGARMAYDI: 'two
    blue cars' ('blues' EMAS!)
  3 FIKR sifati FAKT sifatidan
    oldin: 'an EXPENSIVE long dress'


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  FAKT SIFATLARI TARTIBI          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  1 O'LChAM (size): small, big,
    short, long
  2 OG'IRLIK (weight): heavy, light
  3 ShAKL (shape): triangular,
    round, rectangular, square
  4 RANG (colour): dark/light blue,
    yellow, pink, cream, red, purple
  5 MATERIAL: cotton, leather, silk,
    plastic, woollen, nylon, metal,
    gold, silver, velvet, wooden,
    canvas

  MISOL:
  'an EXPENSIVE (fikr), SHORT
   (o'lcham), BLACK (rang), LEATHER
   (material) jacket'


⚠ FIKR SIFATLARI:

  beautiful, great, expensive,
  nice, lovely, awful ...
  = biz nima deb O'YLAYMIZ.


⚠ FAKT SIFATLARI:

  short, long, red ...
  = HAQIQATAN qanday.


⚠ MATERIALLAR:

  cotton = paxta; leather = teri;
  silk = ipak; woollen = jun;
  velvet = baxmal; wooden = yog'och;
  canvas = brezent.


⚠ ShAKLLAR:

  triangular = uchburchak; round =
  dumaloq; rectangular =
  to'rtburchak; square = kvadrat.

points.en: Adjectives describe nouns. They go before nouns. They have the same form in the singular and plural. (a blue car - two blue cars)
points.uz: Sifatlar otlarni tasvirlaydi. Ular otdan oldin keladi. Birlik va ko'plikda bir xil shaklda. (ko'k mashina - ikkita ko'k mashina)

points.en: There are two types of adjectives: Opinion adjectives (beautiful, great, expensive etc) which show what we think of someone or something and fact adjectives (short, long, red etc) which show what someone or something really is. Opinion adjectives go before fact adjectives. She's wearing an expensive long dress.
points.uz: Ikki xil sifat bor: fikr sifatlari (chiroyli, ajoyib, qimmat) - biz kimdir yoki nimadir haqida nima deb o'ylashimizni ko'rsatadi; fakt sifatlari (kalta, uzun, qizil) - haqiqatan qanday ekanini ko'rsatadi. Fikr sifatlari fakt sifatlaridan oldin keladi. U qimmat uzun ko'ylak kiygan.

points.en: When there are two or more fact adjectives, they go in this order: size, weight, shape, colour, material. It's an expensive, short, black, leather jacket.
points.uz: Ikki yoki undan ko'p fakt sifati bo'lsa, tartib: o'lcham, og'irlik, shakl, rang, material. Bu qimmat, kalta, qora, teri kurtka.

exercises.instructionEn: Making Comparisons. One-syllable adjectives: cheap - cheaper - the cheapest; large - larger - the largest; big - bigger - the biggest. -y adjectives: noisy - noisier - the noisiest. Adjectives with two or more syllables: expensive - more expensive - the most expensive. Irregular: good - better - the best; bad - worse - the worst; much/many - more - the most; little - less - the least.
exercises.instructionUz: Qiyoslash. Bir bo'g'inli sifatlar: cheap - cheaper - the cheapest; large - larger - the largest; big - bigger - the biggest. -y sifatlar: noisy - noisier - the noisiest. Ikki va undan ko'p bo'g'inli: expensive - more expensive - the most expensive. Noto'g'ri: good - better - the best; bad - worse - the worst; much/many - more - the most; little - less - the least.
exercises.explanationUz:
QIYoSIY va ORTTIRMA DARAJA.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  BIR BO'G'INLI: -ER / -EST       ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  cheap → cheapER → the cheapEST
  large → largER → the largEST
    (-e bilan tugasa faqat -r/-st)
  big → biGGer → the biGGest
    (unli + undosh → ikkilanadi)


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  -Y SIFATLAR: -IER / -IEST       ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  noisy → noisIER → the noisIEST
  happy → happier → the happiest


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  2+ BO'G'INLI: MORE / MOST       ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  expensive → MORE expensive →
    the MOST expensive
  ⚠ 'expensiver' - XATO!


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  NOTO'G'RI                       ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  good → better → the best
  bad → worse → the worst
  much/many → more → the most
  little → less → the least


⚠ ORTTIRMA DARAJADA 'THE':

  'the cheapest', 'the best'.


⚠ QIYoSLASh QOLIPI:

  X is cheapER THAN Y.
  X is the cheapEST (in/of ...).


⚠ 'A SYLLABLE':

  = bo'g'in.

points.en: One-syllable adjectives: cheap - cheaper - the cheapest; large - larger - the largest; big - bigger - the biggest.
points.uz: Bir bo'g'inli sifatlar: cheap - cheaper - the cheapest; large - larger - the largest; big - bigger - the biggest.

points.en: Adjectives with two or more syllables: expensive - more expensive - the most expensive.
points.uz: Ikki va undan ko'p bo'g'inli sifatlar: expensive - more expensive - the most expensive.

points.en: Irregular adjectives: good - better - the best; bad - worse - the worst; much/many - more - the most; little - less - the least.
points.uz: Noto'g'ri sifatlar: good - better - the best; bad - worse - the worst; much/many - more - the most; little - less - the least.

patterns.exampleEn: I used to work as a cleaner.

patterns.formula: a/an + FIKR + O'LChAM + RANG + MATERIAL + OT
patterns.exampleEn: It's an expensive, short, black, leather jacket.
patterns.exampleUz: Bu qimmat, kalta, qora, teri kurtka.

patterns.formula: X is + SIFAT-ER / more + SIFAT + than Y.
patterns.exampleEn: This car is cheaper than that one. It's more expensive than mine.
patterns.exampleUz: Bu mashina anavidan arzonroq. U menikidan qimmatroq.

patterns.formula: X is the + SIFAT-EST / most + SIFAT.
patterns.exampleEn: It's the biggest house in the street.
